# discord_integrations (Data Source)

Lists the integrations of a server, such as bots and Twitch or YouTube connections. Requires the Manage Server permission. Discord returns at most 50 integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_integrations" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `integrations` (Attributes List) The integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) ID of the integration's account; for a bot, its user ID.
- `account_name` (String) Name of the integration's account.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is enabled.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `name` (String) Integration name.
- `type` (String) Integration type: `discord`, `twitch`, `youtube` or `guild_subscription`.
